messages:
Sam: Quick heads up — customer reported that their Insights cohort dashboard showed rows from another cohort after the morning routing change. Screenshot shared privately.
Priya: Which change? the cohort-routing flag we rolled at 09:15?
Alex: Yeah that canary. We flipped routing->cohort-affinity v2.
Mei: Interesting — any pattern? only on quick-filters or across all queries?
Sam: Only on the console Insights panel and the quick-filter dropdown. Appears instantly after switching org context.
Jordan: Could be cache key. I remember we introduced cache sharding but maybe didn't include cohort header.
Priya: Can you paste the relevant proxy logs?
Sam: From proxy logs around 09:17:
```
GET /api/insights?panel=cohort&limit=50 200 cache=HIT cohort=null resp_cached=true X-Cohort-Header: cohort-221
```
Priya: Wait cache says cohort=null but header present — that implies the cache key didn't incorporate X-Cohort.
Alex: Confirmed. Middleware in the edge layer builds cache key from path+user_id+route_tag but we didn't add 'cohort_tag' because it was new. Bug introduced in PR #4877.
Mei: That also explains telemetry — our usage attribution uses cohort_tag on the payload, but if cached response served without cohort in key, telemetry tags were wrong.
Jordan: Immediate plan: rollback the canary routing flag to restore previous behaviour, and patch cache key to include `cohort_tag` and `X-Cohort`.
Priya: Agree — Alex can you cut rollback now? :eyes:
Alex: Rolling back canary now. deploy-bot: `rollback started` :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: rollback complete — canary reverted (deploy id: d-2026-09)
Sam: After rollback, customer confirmed Insights no longer shows cross-cohort rows.
Mei: I'll open a telemetry PR to backfill cohort tags where possible and add a guard in metrics pipeline to flag responses served from cache when cohort header missing.
Jordan: We should also add an automated unit/integration test verifying cache key includes all routing headers (`X-Cohort`, `X-Org`, `X-Routing-Tag`).
Priya: And a rollout UX followup — the console rollout page should warn when enabling routing changes that affect cache keys. Product needs to ack.
Alex: PR incoming for cache key change and tests, targeting hotfix branch. I'll also add a changelog entry.
Priya: Filing an internal incident ticket and assigning owners: Alex (rollback + code fix), Mei (telemetry), Jordan (tests), Sam (customer comms). I'll write up postmortem template.
Sam: Customer update done — apologies, offered extra support and explained canary timeline. They are ok for now.
Jordan: Note for future: any routing header used in routing decisions must be part of the persisted cache key and included in telemetry schema. Add to onboarding doc.
Mei: Adding that to infra runbook. :memo:
Priya: Thanks everyone. Closing thread when PRs merged. :thumbsup:
